## New in this release

### New
- Absences: each absence now says **Whole day** (you missed every lesson of that day; cancelled lessons don't count) or **Partial** with how many of the day's lessons it touches, e.g. "Partial · 1 of 6 lessons". This comes from your timetable.
- Absences: **By subject** shows, for the chosen time range up to today, your attendance in each subject as a percentage, how many lessons you missed (and how many of those are unexcused) and the time missed, plus your attendance in all subjects. Lessons with a late arrival or leaving early count as missed; the percentage counts only the minutes you weren't there. Timetable weeks already on the device aren't downloaded again.

### Changed
- Favourites in Browse timetables: a starred class or teacher now also stays in its place in the list; the "Favourites" section at the top shows a copy.
